items.title: Google Cloud Moves the Compute Engine API to Immutable Date-Based Versions
items.summary: Google Cloud has made date-based versioning of the Compute Engine API generally available, replacing the single mutable /v1 surface with immutable quarterly snapshots such as 2026-09-01, selected per request with a header or query parameter. New versions can change defaults, error formats, and IAM checks without touching /v1 callers, a model Azure Resource Manager and Stripe have used for years. By Steef-Jan Wiggers

items.title: Azure Logic Apps Standard Gets a Local CLI in Preview
items.summary: Microsoft has released a public preview of the logicapp extension for the Azure CLI, adding local project creation, workflow authoring, a runtime lifecycle, connector management, run inspection, and test scaffolding for Logic Apps Standard, work that previously required the VS Code extension. items.title: Dropbox Shares How Its In-House Cookie Auditor Tests Consent Behaviour Across 200+ Web Surfaces
items.summary: Dropbox engineers described a Playwright-based auditor that checks cookie consent behavior across more than 200 web surfaces.
